<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def green_pos():
    for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='N':
            b=n['boundary']; rs=[p[0] for p in b]; cs=[p[1] for p in b]
            return (min(rs),min(cs))
    return None
print("green start:", green_pos())
# moves from (38,10) to each of 9 positions
seqs = {
 (38,8):['LEFT'], (38,12):['RIGHT'],
 (40,8):['DOWN','LEFT'], (40,10):['DOWN'], (40,12):['DOWN','RIGHT'],
 (42,8):['DOWN','DOWN','LEFT'], (42,10):['DOWN','DOWN'], (42,12):['DOWN','DOWN','RIGHT'],
}
for pos,seq in seqs.items():
    for mv in seq: action([mv])
    comp = last_action_result.get('level_completed') or last_action_result.get('done')
    print(pos, "green=",green_pos(), "comp=",comp)
    if comp: print("DONE!"); break
# return to center
print("final green:", green_pos())
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
